sa: युञ्जानः प्रथमं मनस् तत्वाय सविता धियः  ।
अग्नेर् ज्योतिर् निचाय्य पृथिव्या अध्य् आभरत् ॥
iast: yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ manas tatvāya savitā dhiyaḥ  ।
agner jyotir nicāyya pṛthivyā adhy ābharat ॥

tr.text: First harnessing the mind and the senses with a view to realizing the Truth, and then having found out the light of the fire, the Evolving Soul brought itself out of the earth.

sa: युक्तेन मनसा वयं देवस्य सवितुः सवे  ।
सुवर्गेयाय शक्त्या ॥
iast: yuktena manasā vayaṃ devasya savituḥ save  ।
suvargeyāya śaktyā ॥
words: one who sets in motion or impels; an instigator; stimulator

tr.text: With our minds controlled so as to manifest the self-luminous Immanent Soul, we shall vigorously endeavour for the attainment of supreme bliss.

sa: युक्त्वाय मनसा देवान् सुवर् यतो धिया दिवं  ।
बृहज् ज्योतिः करिष्यतः सविता प्रसुवाति तान् ॥
iast: yuktvāya manasā devān suvar yato dhiyā divaṃ  ।
bṛhaj jyotiḥ kariṣyataḥ savitā prasuvāti tān ॥

tr.text: Controlling the heaven-aspiring senses with the help of the mind and the intellect, the Immanent Soul so regenerates them as to enable them to manifest the self-luminous Infinite Light.

sa: युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः  ।
वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविद् एक इन् मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः ॥
iast: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ  ।
vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvid eka in mahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ ॥
words: a sage; a singer; a poet
a sage; a singer; a poet
sacrificing; the function or office of the Hotṛ; a burnt-offering
learned in rules; well versed in ordinances

tr.text: Great is the glory of the Immanent Soul who is all-pervading, all-knowing, infinite and selfluminous. Only those rare few who know, undergo the necessary discipline and spiritual practices. The wise do, indeed, control the activities of the intellect, and practise meditation and concentration.

sa: युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर् वि श्लोक एतु पथ्येव सूरेः  ।
शृण्वन्ति विश्वे अमृतस्य पुत्रा आ ये धामानि दिवियानि तस्थुः ॥
iast: yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhir vi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ  ।
śṛṇvanti viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni diviyāni tasthuḥ ॥
words: the sun; Calotropis Gigantea; a wise or learned man

tr.text: Following only in the footsteps of the wise, I merge you both in the ancient Brahman by continued meditation. May the Glorious One manifest Himself ! May the sons of Immortal Bliss hearken to me – even they who occupy celestial regions !

sa: अग्निर् यत्राभिमथ्यते वायुर् यत्राधिरुध्यते  ।
सोमो यत्रातिरिच्यते तत्र संजायते मनः ॥
iast: agnir yatrābhimathyate vāyur yatrādhirudhyate  ।
somo yatrātiricyate tatra saṃjāyate manaḥ ॥
words: to put to (as horses to a carriage) for a special purpose (acc.); to attack; to assail
to be left with a surplus; to surpass (in a good or bad sense with abl. or acc.)
to be born or produced together with (abl.); to be born from

tr.text: Where fire is churned out, where air is controlled, where Soma juice overflows – there the mind attains perfection.

sa: सवित्रा प्रसवेन जुषेत ब्रह्म पूर्व्यम्  ।
तत्र योनिं कृणवसे नहि ते पूर्तम् अक्षिपत् ॥
iast: savitrā prasavena juṣeta brahma pūrvyam  ।
tatra yoniṃ kṛṇavase nahi te pūrtam akṣipat ॥
words: setting or being set in motion; impulse; course
for not; surely not; by no means
to throw; to cast; to send

tr.text: Attaining whom thou destroyest the source and art no more troubled by the results of past actions – to that ancient Brahman be thou devoted through the Prime Cause, the Immanent Soul.

sa: त्रिरुन्नतं स्थाप्य समं शरीरं हृदीन्द्रियाणि मनसा संनिवेश्य  ।
ब्रह्मोडुपेन प्रतरेत विद्वान् स्रोतांसि सर्वाणि भयावहानि ॥
iast: trirunnataṃ sthāpya samaṃ śarīraṃ hṛdīndriyāṇi manasā saṃniveśya  ।
brahmoḍupena pratareta vidvān srotāṃsi sarvāṇi bhayāvahāni ॥
words: to bend upwards; to raise one's self; to rise
to cause to stand; to place; to locate
to cause to enter or sit down together; to introduce into or lodge in; to set down
a raft or float; a kind of drinking vessel covered with leather
to go to sea; to pass over; to cross
the current or bed of a river; a river; stream

tr.text: Placing the body in a straight posture, holding the chest, throat and head erect, and drawing the senses and the mind into the heart, the knowing one should cross over all the fearful currents by means of the raft of Brahman.

sa: प्राणान् प्रपीड्येह स युक्तचेष्टः क्षीने प्राणे नासिकयोच्छ्वसीत  ।
दुष्टाश्वयुक्तम् इव वाहम् एनं विद्वान् मनो धारयेताप्रमत्तः ॥
iast: prāṇān prapīḍyeha sa yuktaceṣṭaḥ kṣīne prāṇe nāsikayocchvasīta  ।
duṣṭāśvayuktam iva vāham enaṃ vidvān mano dhārayetāpramattaḥ ॥
words: to press; to squeeze; to suppress (the breath)
to breathe hard; to snort; to take a deep breath
to hold; to keep; to possess

tr.text: Controlling the senses with an effort, and regulating the activities in the body, one should breathe out through the nostrils when the vital activities become gentle. Then the knowing one, without being in the least distracted, should keep his hold on the mind as on the reins attached to restive horses.

sa: समे शुचौ शर्करावह्निवालुका- विवर्जिते शब्दजलाश्रयादिभिः  ।
मनोऽनुकूले न तु चक्षुपीडने गुहानिवाताश्रयणे प्रयोजयेत् ॥
iast: same śucau śarkarāvahnivālukā- vivarjite śabdajalāśrayādibhiḥ  ।
mano’nukūle na tu cakṣupīḍane guhānivātāśrayaṇe prayojayet ॥
words: any animal that draws or bears along; a draught animal; horse
water; any fluid; a kind of Andropogon
that to which anything is annexed or with which anything is closely connected or on which…
according to the current; favourable; friendly
the eye; the Oxus river; name of a Marudvat
betaking one's self or applying to; joining; accepting
to utter; to pronounce; to show

tr.text: One should perform one’s exercises in concentration, resorting to caves and such other pure places helpful to its practice – places where the ground is level without pebbles, and the scenery pleasing to the eyes; where there is no wind, dust, fire, dampness and disturbing noises.

sa: नीहारधूमार्कानलानिलानां खद्योतविद्युत्स्फटिकाशशीनाम्  ।
एतानि रूपाणि पुरःसराणि ब्रह्मण्य् अभिव्यक्तिकराणि योगे ॥
iast: nīhāradhūmārkānalānilānāṃ khadyotavidyutsphaṭikāśaśīnām  ।
etāni rūpāṇi puraḥsarāṇi brahmaṇy abhivyaktikarāṇi yoge ॥
words: a ray; flash of lightning; the sun
fire; the god of fire; digestive power
the moon; name of a son of the daughter of Kaṅka

tr.text: Forms that appear like snow, smoke, sun, wind, fire, fire-fly, lightning, crystal and moon, precede the manifestation of Brahman in Yoga practice.

sa: पृथ्व्यप्तेजोऽनिलखे समुत्थिते पञ्चात्मके योगगुणे प्रवृत्ते  ।
न तस्य रोगो न जरा न मृत्युः प्राप्तस्य योगाग्निमयं शरीरम् ॥
iast: pṛthvyaptejo’nilakhe samutthite pañcātmake yogaguṇe pravṛtte  ।
na tasya rogo na jarā na mṛtyuḥ prāptasya yogāgnimayaṃ śarīram ॥
words: the earth; Nigella Indica; Boerhavia Procumbens

tr.text: When the fivefold perception of Yoga, arising from (concentrating the mind on) earth, water, light, air and ether, have appeared to the Yogin, then he has become possessed of a body made of the fire of Yoga, and he will not be touched by disease, old age or death.

sa: लघुत्वम् आरोग्यम् अलोलुपत्वं वर्णप्रसादः स्वरसौष्ठवं च  ।
गन्धः शुभो मूत्रपुरीषम् अल्पं योगप्रवृत्तिं प्रथमां वदन्ति ॥
iast: laghutvam ārogyam alolupatvaṃ varṇaprasādaḥ svarasauṣṭhavaṃ ca  ।
gandhaḥ śubho mūtrapurīṣam alpaṃ yogapravṛttiṃ prathamāṃ vadanti ॥
words: freedom from disease; health; a particular ceremony
very destructive; destroying; very desirous or eager or covetous
excellence; superior goodness or beauty; extreme skilfulness

tr.text: It is said that the first signs of entering Yoga are lightness of body, health, thirstlessness of mind, clearness of complexion, a beautiful voice, an agreeable odour and scantiness excretions.

sa: यथैव बिम्बं मृदयोपलिप्तं तेजोमयं भ्राजते तत् सुधान्तम्  ।
तद् वात्मतत्त्वं प्रसमीक्ष्य देही एकः कृतार्थो भवते वीतशोकः ॥
iast: yathaiva bimbaṃ mṛdayopaliptaṃ tejomayaṃ bhrājate tat sudhāntam  ।
tad vātmatattvaṃ prasamīkṣya dehī ekaḥ kṛtārtho bhavate vītaśokaḥ ॥
words: the disk of the sun or moon; any disk; sphere
to defile; to besmear (esp. with cow-dung); to smear
to look at or upon; to observe; to perceive

tr.text: Just as the same metal disc, which was stained by dust before, shines brilliantly when cleaned, so the embodied being, seeing the truth of Atman, realizes oneness, attains the goal and becomes sorrowless.

sa: यद् आत्मतत्त्वेन तु ब्रह्मतत्त्वं दीपोपमेनेह युक्तः प्रपश्येत्  ।
अजं ध्रुवं सर्वतत्त्वैर् विशुद्धं ज्ञात्वा देवं मुच्यते सर्वपाशैः ॥
iast: yad ātmatattvena tu brahmatattvaṃ dīpopameneha yuktaḥ prapaśyet  ।
ajaṃ dhruvaṃ sarvatattvair viśuddhaṃ jñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāśaiḥ ॥
words: to see before one's eyes; to look at; to observe

tr.text: When the Yogin realizes the truth of Brahman, through the perception of the truth of Atman in this body as a self-luminous entity, then, knowing the Divinity as unborn, eternal and free from all the modifications of Prakriti, he is freed from all sins.

sa: एष ह देवः प्रदिशो ऽनु सर्वाः पूर्वो ह जातः स उ गर्भे अन्तः  ।
स एव जातः स जनिष्यमानः प्रत्यङ् जनास् तिष्ठति सर्वतोमुखः ॥
iast: eṣa ha devaḥ pradiśo ’nu sarvāḥ pūrvo ha jātaḥ sa u garbhe antaḥ  ।
sa eva jātaḥ sa janiṣyamānaḥ pratyaṅ janās tiṣṭhati sarvatomukhaḥ ॥
words: pointing to or out; indication; direction
facing in all direction; turned every where; complete

tr.text: This Divinity pervades all directions in their entirety. He is the first-born (Hiranyagarbha). He has entered into the womb. He alone is born, and is to be born in future. He is inside all persons as the Indwelling Self, facing all directions.

sa: यो देवो अग्नौ यो अप्सु यो विश्वं भुवनम् आविवेश  ।
य ओषधीषु यो वनस्पतीषु तस्मै देवाय नमो नमः ॥
iast: yo devo agnau yo apsu yo viśvaṃ bhuvanam āviveśa  ।
ya oṣadhīṣu yo vanaspatīṣu tasmai devāya namo namaḥ ॥

tr.text: Salutations to that Divinity who is in the fire, who is in the water, who is in the plants, who is in the trees, who has pervaded the whole universe.
